value.rationale: A complete local dependence-sign phase and exact \(n^{-2}\) threshold at the natural Dirichlet/Pitman–Yor boundary quantify how a tiny positive discount reverses competition/coexistence of once-seen versus twice-seen species. The fixed positive-strength domain and asymptotic window are mathematically motivated; the claim does not depend on an arbitrary integer table or a routine normalization identity.
